goal: RA-8212: pr-ready-guard warns and passes when GitHub denies drafting an unrelated PR; triggering PR rules unchanged

criteria.text: A sweep where GitHub returns FORBIDDEN on convertPullRequestToDraft for a PR other than the triggering PR (or on a sweep run with no triggering PR) exits 0 and prints a ::warning:: line
FORBIDDEN on the triggering PR itself, any non-FORBIDDEN error, and FORBIDDEN on a different mutation all still exit 1
criteria.recipe: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_pr_ready_guard.py -q -p no:cacheprovider -k 'triggering_pr_draft_forbidden or other_error or different_mutation'

criteria.text: When drafting succeeds, unrelated and triggering PRs are both drafted and the run exits 0
Whole ready-guard test file passes, including all pre-existing decide()/classify tests
Ruff clean on the two changed files, and the repo's file and function length gates pass
